name: scraptest
description: scrapTest monorepo: NestJS (Fastify) + Prisma 7 API and Next.js web app

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @scraptest/contracts build && pnpm --filter @scraptest/api build && pnpm --filter @scraptest/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @scraptest/contracts lint && pnpm --filter @scraptest/api lint && pnpm --filter @scraptest/web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @scraptest/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @scraptest/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @scraptest/web typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
